data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Testament name 'Shur', meaning 'peace', and 'wood', meaning 'forest'. This name carries the symbolism of living in peace and tranquility, surrounded by the natural beauty of the forest. The name Shurwood carries the meaning “The forest of peace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Shurwood usually hope their child will grow to embody the forest of peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
